responsibility: This definition module declares the Logitech-compatible keyboard input interface used by the terminal subsystem. It provides blocking character input from standard input and a nonblocking readiness query, abstracting raw keyboard polling away from higher-level modules such as Terminal and InOut.
same_name_distinction: Definition half of the Keyboard pair: it declares the blocking Read and nonblocking KeyPressed entry points, while Keyboard.mod contains the stdin/select-based implementation.
